title: game_full 1.0 - merged full-game timeline
description: Merge layer over the two single-perspective analyses (D7a). Every ply appears exactly once, eval fields are White POV, and the mover-POV value is published next to the White-POV value so the invariant is checkable. cp_loss is a loss magnitude and is never sign-flipped. A value that was not measured is null, never 0. Structural validation is mirrored by services/timeline.validate_game_full(), which also enforces ply parity, the POV sign invariant and the complete/partial consistency.

white.description: White player name from the PGN headers.

black.description: Black player name from the PGN headers.

status.description: 'complete' requires a known plies_total, every ply merged, no unmeasured ply and both colours present. Anything else is 'partial' and the gap is named.

plies_total.description: Total plies from the PGN walk. null when no source analysis recorded it (legacy cache) - never a guessed length.

missing_plies.description: Plies inside 1..plies_total that no analysis measured. Empty when plies_total is null, because the range is unknown.

unanalyzed_plies.description: Plies present in a payload but explicitly unmeasured (engine error/budget). Their cp_loss and eval fields are null.

missing_colours.description: Colours with no source analysis at all. Non-empty implies status=partial.

source.description: Both perspectives are always present. available=false means that colour was not analysed at all; such an entry publishes no measurement (acpl=null, moves_measured=0).

mode.description: Engine policy that produced this perspective (fast/deep/legacy).

acpl.description: ACPL for this perspective; null when available=false.

mover_color.description: Must match ply parity: odd = white, even = black. Validated semantically.

class.description: null when the ply was not measured.

cp_loss.description: Loss magnitude for the mover, never sign-flipped. null exactly when analyzed=false.

eval_before_mover_cp.description: Engine eval before the move, from the mover's POV. null when unmeasured.

eval_after_mover_cp.description: Engine eval after the move, still from the mover's POV (not flipped). null when unmeasured.

eval_before_white_cp.description: eval_before_mover_cp in White POV: identical for White, negated for Black.

eval_after_white_cp.description: eval_after_mover_cp in White POV: identical for White, negated for Black.

win_prob_white_before.description: Win probability in White POV; flipped (1 - p) for Black moves.

win_prob_white_after.description: Win probability in White POV; flipped (1 - p) for Black moves.

best.description: Engine's preferred SAN at this ply; empty when unmeasured.
